observed_failure.cause: The bound RunPod guest contains no docker, podman, nerdctl, ctr, containerd, apptainer, or singularity executable, and the system Python has no vLLM distribution. The image-only owner therefore cannot launch the bound OCI digest.

required_actions: Stop issuing container-runtime-only replacement owners while the guest has no container runtime.

Resolve one official current vLLM Linux distribution for the existing Python/CUDA-compatible guest path and bind its exact version, URL or repository commit, and content SHA-256. Prefer an official vLLM nightly wheel in an isolated uv environment under /workspace; do not mutate the system SGLang environment.

If the inspected official wheel cannot support this Python, CUDA, or sm_120 runtime, persist a typed unsupported result with the exact resolver/import diagnostic instead of compiling an unbounded source stack.

Patch run_vllm_sm120_fp8_endpoint_owner.py so the replacement supervises the exact native vLLM executable and PID directly, persists package and executable identities, detects a dead server immediately, and does not require or emulate Docker.
Treat the already absent exact SGLang predecessor and empty accelerator as a settled fence after one strict confirmation; do not try to kill PID 16036 again.
Run one no-HTTP target-GPU import of the installed vLLM Gemma4 model class and FP8 configuration before server load. This is pre-science runtime evidence, not a canonical request.
Hash-bind the amended owner and a NATIVE_VLLM_RUNTIME_RESULT.json, then publish the scope-matched request for the current repair generation.

After the waiting owner accepts the request, replace only its exact PID/start-ticks generation with one durable --resume-claimed owner. Preserve the original claim timestamp and update STATUS.json.active_session atomically before yielding.
